research_question: What is the effect of Mental Health First Aid (MHFA) training compared with a control condition on trainees' ability to correctly recognise depression in a case vignette at follow-up of six months or longer?
control_label: Control (waitlist, no training, or unrelated activity)
outcome_description: Proportion of participants correctly identifying depression in a case vignette at follow-up of six months or longer
positive_direction: Increased odds of correctly recognising depression favoring MHFA training (OR > 1)
search_queries: Mental Health First Aid depression recognition trial
MHFA randomized controlled trial depression vignette
Mental Health First Aid training evaluation controlled comparison
inclusion_criteria: Randomised controlled trials (including cluster-RCTs) evaluating Mental Health First Aid (MHFA) training compared to a control condition (waitlist, no training, or unrelated activity)
Assessment of participants' ability to correctly recognise or identify depression in a case vignette at a follow-up of six months or longer
Reporting of quantitative outcome data (e.g., frequencies, percentages, odds ratios with 95% CIs, or continuous recognition scores)
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, protocols, editorials, opinion pieces, or theoretical papers)
No comparison between an MHFA training condition and an eligible control condition (e.g., uncontrolled pre-post studies)
No quantitative outcome data allowing calculation of an effect size for vignette-based depression recognition at follow-up >= 6 months
Completely unrelated topic or studies only assessing outcomes immediately post-training (< 6 months) without long-term follow-up
moderators_to_extract: Control condition type (waitlist, no training, active/unrelated control)
Target population (e.g., workplaces, university students, general public)
effect_size_note: Odds ratio (OR) of correct depression recognition in a vignette (MHFA vs control) at the first follow-up >= 6 months. Cluster trials adjusted for design effect if not already adjusted. If continuous recognition scores are reported, SMD is converted to log OR via SMD * pi / sqrt(3). Multiple training arms combined.
